scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: Reed College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF sections A-J, Institutional Research; G revised 2026-05-11, H 2026-04-07)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 9,606 applied, 2,804 admitted, 342 enrolled; residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 4,485 applied, 295 admitted, 32 enrolled. The CDS leaves the early decision and early action application counts (C21/C22) blank, so those fields are empty. Reed is test-blind (SAT/ACT are not used in admission), but the CDS still reports scores from students who sent them: 61% (209 students) SAT and 25% (84) ACT, so the percentiles below describe those students only. The average high school GPA is printed as 4.00 (the CDS does not say whether it is weighted) for the 87.43% of first-years who reported a GPA; the distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column (4.0 scale).

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set G1/G5 (section G revised 2026-05-11): tuition $73,960, required fees $310 (student body fee), housing only $9,720 and food only $8,750 (the combined food-and-housing row is blank, so no room-and-board total is shown), books and supplies $1,050, other expenses $900; transportation is printed as 'varies'. The CDS text asks for 2025-2026 in G1 but these amounts equal the 2026-27 rates on Reed's own tuition page (tuition $73,960, student body fee $310, dormitory room $9,720, Board Plan A $9,180, total direct costs $93,170), so they are labelled 2026-27. Aid to nonresidents (CDS H6, 2025-26 estimated column): only institutional need-based grant aid is offered (no non-need-based aid); 71 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received it, average $65,475, total $4,648,738.
